snippet_primary: > "The standard credit and debit card payment fee is 2.99% + a fixed fee per transaction, which varies according to the transaction currency. An additional 1.5% applies to international commercial transactions. Note that these fees are collected by PayPal and do not go to Payhip."
subject_exact: Payhip help center (help.payhip.com/article/64-connecting-your-paypal-account, undated) states PayPal standard credit/debit card fee is 2.99%+fixed fee per transaction (fixed fee varies by currency); additional 1.5% applies to international commercial transactions; fees collected by PayPal, not Payhip
metric_value_raw: 2.99% + fixed fee per transaction (currency-dependent); +1.5% for international commercial transactions
